infoSnippets.breadcrumb: Create your first application > Connect GitHub
infoSnippets.content: Open the Porter dashboard, click Create Application, and connect the repository.

infoSnippets.breadcrumb: Create your first application > Select repository
infoSnippets.content: Choose the repository and branch that you want Porter to deploy.
Review the applications detected from your repository in the dashboard.
Click Deploy when the configuration looks correct.
